theAcquisitionProcessNeverReceives.note: Every entry is false: none of these is passed to, imported by, or reachable from the acquisition path.

harnessEntryPointCaveat.concern: runCaseArtifacts takes an eval case object which, in the harness's normal use, carries brand truth alongside the image.
harnessEntryPointCaveat.mitigation: The acquisition constructs its case objects from the truth-free input manifest only, leaving truth fields unset, and asserts before each call that the object carries no acceptable-value array. This is an input-construction discipline, not a harness change.
harnessEntryPointCaveat.assertionOnFailure: TRUTH_ISOLATION_FAILURE, before any OCR call for that case

checks: no banned field name appears as a JSON key
no governed acceptable-value string appears anywhere in the emitted evidence except where it is genuinely part of an OCR-recognized text or a candidate value produced by the pipeline
the second check is reported as an inventory rather than a hard failure, because a correct OCR reading of a brand legitimately contains the brand string
scanBeforeFreeze.hardFailure: a banned field NAME appearing as a key halts with TRUTH_ISOLATION_FAILURE

orderingRule: Both runs complete, and both raw-evidence manifests are written and hashed, BEFORE any governed truth file is opened.

permitted: verify the new evidence can rederive the previously carried determinations
compare the new current-base snapshot with the older evidence artifact
forbidden: reordering, re-emitting or reformatting any frozen raw file
